source_of_truth: Operator directive: after Plan A (architecture evidence contract) and 008 (operator-console usability), the next reconciler slice is Plan B — an ADR/doc intent extractor that populates the intent.claims Plan A's layer shell reserved empty, plus a bounded as-built vs intended reconciler that populates the diff list keyed by Plan A's diff taxonomy. ADR parsing only; no new code/language extractors (Plan C); no UI; no Plan A contract change; graceful when a repo has no ADRs.
completion_test: build_view_state populates layers.intent with declared intent claims parsed from decision docs (id/title/status/source_path/referenced symbols; source_kind adr; evidence_basis declared) and degrades to empty + coverage adr=not_found when none exist; and populates layers.diff with conservative, evidence-backed entries keyed by the Plan A taxonomy (aligned / documented_unimplemented / stale_adr in v0). The extractor + reconciler are pure, deterministic, and entered through the real build_view_state surface.

user_journeys.name: adr-intent-surfaces
user_journeys.description: A repo with an ADR yields a declared intent claim in the view-state intent layer.

user_journeys.name: as-built-vs-intended
user_journeys.description: Each claim is reconciled against the as-built graph into an honest diff entry.

non_goals: New code/build/language extractors (Plan C owns those)
UI rendering of the intent/diff layers (later slice)
Any change to the Plan A contract enums or the as-built builder
